messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Reproductive health, Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions, and Family life and marriage in Germany during the 1980s, matching this research need: survey data on sexuality attitudes, sexual behavior, AIDS knowledge and prevention, condom use, partnerships, heterosexual and homosexual experiences, prostitution contacts, sexual practices, and effects of HIV/AIDS on sexual life
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
